Ivy (Starboard): hey folks — onboarding warmup failing: sporadic 401s and then a cascade of 429s when our CI spins up 40 parallel workers. started after switching to the new node sdk v3.0.0-rc. staging only.
Marta (CSM): ugh, thanks Ivy. can you paste the SDK init + a trimmed log sample? looping in @Eli and @Noah.
Ivy (Starboard): init: `const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_TOKEN, maxConcurrency: 12, retry: { maxAttempts: 5 } })`
Ivy (Starboard): log snippet: 
```
POST /v1/generate 401 { id: "req_zx1...", error: "unauthorized", hint: "no auth provided" }
// then many requests show 429 Retry-After: 0
```
Ivy (Starboard): token lifted from our CI token service; TTL is 90s. env var present on runner. curl from same host returns 200.
Eli (SDK): two common patterns: 1) header gets stripped by intermediary (edge function/gateway) 2) token TTL too short for big fanout -> some runners mint tokens that already expired by the time they hit the service. also v3 rc had a retry-plugin change that treats `Retry-After: 0` as immediate retry by default.
Noah (SRE): i'm seeing traces for your org where `x-internal-proxy: fn-fanout` and `authorization:` missing on the outbound lambda call. that matches header drop. also your warmup pattern shows a 30s plateau where lots of tokens were minted ~20s before workers started. TTL 90s might be fine but clock skew + queueing could make some tokens expire.
Marta (CSM): ok action: can you check header forwarding in your fanout function and token issuance timing? i can request a temporary onboarding quota increase while you remediate.
Ivy (Starboard): header forwarder had a default whitelist — Authorization wasn't included for internal fetches. adding it now. also will add a 200-500ms randomized splay before worker init.
Eli (SDK): short-term SDK tips: set `respectRetryAfter: true` and `retry: { maxAttempts: 3, minTimeout: 300, factor: 2 }` and use `maxConcurrency: 6` during warmup. also enable the opt-in `authFallback` helper in v3-rc if your infra strips headers (it will rewrite auth to query param as a fallback). snippet: 
```
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_TOKEN, maxConcurrency: 6, retry: { maxAttempts: 3, respectRetryAfter: true } , authFallback: true })
```
Noah (SRE): i'll temporarily open a rate bump: OPS-4509 created. will monitor traces while you run tests. also check runner ntp.
OpsBot: Ops ticket OPS-4509 created: "Starboard onboarding temporary throttle increase" — assignee infra-ops.
Ivy (Starboard): changed whitelist and splay, re-ran 3 warmups: 401s gone, 429s reduced from ~20% to ~3%. thanks.
Marta (CSM): great! Eli, can you add a short note to the onboarding doc about header whitelisting + splay and recommend `respectRetryAfter` by default?
Eli (SDK): on it — i'll open a tiny PR and backport the retry fix to 3.0.x-stable. PR when ready.
Noah (SRE): postmortem note: if customers must keep short TTLs, advise token exchange pattern (long-lived per runner -> short-lived per request) and strongly recommend heartbeat/refresh rather than mass minting before fanout.
Ivy (Starboard): noted. closing unless it resurfaces. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
